rows = [
    ("ws-ship-nimbus", "orchestrator", "ultra", 6200, 620),
    ("ws-ship-nimbus", "orchestrator", "ultra", 7400, 520),
    ("ws-ship-nimbus", "orchestrator", "ultra", 8900, 300),
    ("ws-ship-nimbus", "analyst", "super", 10400, 520),
    ("ws-ship-nimbus", "analyst", "super", 9800, 340),
    ("ws-ship-nimbus", "writer", "super", 5900, 480),
    ("ws-ship-nimbus", "researcher", "super", 4100, 380),
    ("ws-radar", "orchestrator", "ultra", 5400, 480),
    ("ws-radar", "writer", "super", 6100, 720),
    ("ws-radar", "researcher", "super", 5200, 300),
    ("ws-brief", "writer", "super", 4400, 380),
    ("ws-brief", "analyst", "super", 6600, 520),
    ("ws-checkout", "orchestrator", "ultra", 6900, 560),
    ("ws-checkout", "learner", "nano", 6900, 1100),
]
old = {"ultra": (1.00, 3.00), "super": (0.30, 0.90), "nano": (0.06, 0.24)}
new = {"ultra": (1.00, 3.00), "super": (0.24, 0.72), "nano": (0.06, 0.24)}
def cost(p, tier, i, o):
    return (i * p[tier][0] + o * p[tier][1]) / 1e6
base = sum(cost(old, t, i, o) for _, _, t, i, o in rows)
after_price = sum(cost(new, t, i, o) for _, _, t, i, o in rows)
seen = set(); after_rule = 0.0
for ws, role, t, i, o in rows:
    first = role == "orchestrator" and ws not in seen
    if role == "orchestrator": seen.add(ws)
    after_rule += cost(new, "super" if role == "orchestrator" and not first else t, i, o)
print("week at old prices          $%.4f" % base)
print("week at the new prices      $%.4f   (%.1f%% less)" % (after_price, (1 - after_price / base) * 100))
print("plus the rule below         $%.4f   (%.1f%% less than the new prices, %.1f%% less than now)" % (after_rule, (1 - after_rule / after_price) * 100, (1 - after_rule / base) * 100))
